question: Which of the following is an autobiography of Barack Obama?

options.text: Dreams from my Father: A Story of Race and Inheritance

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dreams from my Father: A Story of Race and Inheritance**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__** 

__
 
• Barack Obama__ has authored the book -‘Dreams From My Father’. This book is a diary of events that explores his early life.
 
• Mr. Obama was the 44th President of the United States of America and 1st Afro-American to be elected as President of the USA.
 
• His Presidential term was from the year 2009 to 2017. He represented the Democratic Party of the USA.
 
• Wife of Mr. Barack Obama, Michelle Obama has authored the following books: 1. American Grown 2. Becoming
 
• Currently, Mr. Joe Biden is serving as the 46th President of the USA. He is a member of the Democratic Party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Chronicles **were the **final book of the Hebrew Bible.**
 
• **Matters of Discretion **is an autobiography by former Prime Minister of India **Inder Kumar Gujral.**
 
• **The Test of My Life: From Cricket to Cancer and Back** is an autobiography of **Yuvraj Singh.**
